text: upon Sigionoth: Or, according to variable songs or tunes called in Hebrew Shigianoth
thy speech: Heb. thy report or thy hearing | revive: Or, preserve alive
horns coming out of his hand: Or, bright beams out of his side
Cushan: Or, Ethiopia | in affliction: Or, under affliction or vanity
thy chariots of salvation?: Or, thy chariots were salvation
Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers: Or, thou didst cleave the rivers of the earth
at the light of thine arrows: Or, thine arrows walked in the light, etc.
came out as a whirlwind: Heb. were tempestuous
invade them: Or, cut them in pieces
